SELECT pd.physregistry AS registry_id, di.makername AS manufacturer, di.modnum AS model_number, pd.durability_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN pd.durability_score > 8 THEN 'High Durability'
        WHEN pd.durability_score BETWEEN 4 AND 8 THEN 'Medium Durability'
        ELSE 'Low Durability'
    END AS durability_category
FROM physicaldurability pd
JOIN interactionandcontrol ic ON pd.physregistry = ic.interactphysref
JOIN deviceidentity di ON ic.interactdevref = di.devregistry
WHERE pd.durability_score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pd.durability_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
